results.title: External validation of clinical prediction models using big datasets from e-health records or IPD meta-analysis: opportunities and challenges | The BMJ
results.content: Access to big datasets from e-health records and individual participant data (IPD) meta-analysis is signalling a new advent of external validation studies for clinical prediction models. Here, we use five empirical examples to demonstrate how big datasets from e-health records or IPD meta-analysis allow researchers to examine heterogeneity and (if necessary) improve the predictive performance of a model across different populations, settings, and subgroups. When data from multiple studies are available for external validation, meta-analysis techniques (such as a random effects meta-analysis52) can be used to quantify and summarise between-study heterogeneity in model performance.305354 For example, Debray and colleagues developed a prediction model for the diagnosis of deep vein thrombosis in patients suspected of having the condition.45 The researchers performed external validation using 12 studies (10 014 patients in total; study sample sizes ranging from 153 to 1768 patients). In conclusion, access to big datasets from, for example, e-health records, registry databases, and IPD meta-analyses should signal a new approach to external validation studies in risk prediction research, for either diagnostic or prognostic purposes.

results.title: Is there a general method to validate a research hypothesis, or does it depend, e.g. on the type of the hypothesis, which methods are applicable? - Quora
results.content: Is there a general method to validate a research hypothesis, or does it depend, e.g. on the type of the hypothesis, which methods are applicable? The value of a hypothesis is equal to the prediction capability of the theory. Hypotheses can be validated by experiments, observations, or by the theory’s predictions based upon them. HU predicts all predictions of General and Special Relativity, the Observations of the Cosmic Microwave Background, located Earth within the Universe, predicts all SN1a distances from their redshifts and showed that GR, SR, and L-CDM are incorrect (by the preponderance of the evidence). A hypothesis should be able to predict a causality or result, and sometimes the means of obtaining that proof may be far in the future, as were the cases of germ theory, relativity, prions, and Higgs bosons. How is hypothesis tested in research? What are some ways to validate research hypotheses before doing any actual work on them? Validation of a research hypothesis is a structured process but not a single universal method: the appropriate validation approach depends on the hypothesis’ type, domain, and practical constraints. Validation of a research hypothesis is a structured process but not a single universal method: the appropriate validation approach depends on the hypothesis’ type, domain, and practical constraints. Hypothesis validation follows a common logic—precise statement, appropriate design, control for alternative explanations, robustness checks, and transparent reporting—but the concrete methods must be selected to match the hypothesis type, available data, and practical constraints. The notion of validation is general across disciplines/hypotheses/methods in that it is a series of research techniques which seek to substantiate research results.
